name: What is the difference between ground-up construction and a major remodel?
description: Ground-up construction builds a new home on vacant land; a major remodel significantly alters an existing structure.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ground-up construction and a major remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ground-up construction involves building a completely new structure on vacant land, offering full design flexibility and the ability to customize every aspect. A major remodel, conversely, involves significant alterations to an existing structure, often retaining a substantial portion of the original foundation and framework. While remodels can be extensive, they are often limited by the existing footprint and structural elements, whereas ground-up construction starts with a blank slate.
